open: Only 1 of 30 inventoried legacy V8 Finance writers has a proven canonical successor and is disabled by default. The remaining 29 stay available and are classified as legacy_uncovered_writer until route-by-route parity, backfill and usage evidence exists.
Rollout timing and Finance/Results reconciliation remain owner decisions; this evidence does not authorize rollout or change Results Actual ownership.

changedPathRationale.server/migrations/20260920_finance_legac: Prevents HTTP retries from inflating cutover evidence for the same tenant/request/method/path/access classification.
changedPathRationale.server/src/services/financeLegacyCutover: Records cutover usage idempotently while keeping protected writes fail-closed even if telemetry fails.
changedPathRationale.server/src/services/__tests__/financeLeg: Adds mounted route, retry, tenant-isolated alias bridge and independent cold-readback proof on fresh PostgreSQL.

commands.command: DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:32929/fin_cutover DB_TYPE=postgres CI=true RUN_DB_TESTS=1 MOCK_DB=false NODE_ENV=test ENABLE_V8_GLOBAL=true npx vitest run server/src/services/__tests__/financeLegacyCutover.test.ts server/src/services/__tests__/financeLegacyCutover.pg.test.ts --no-file-parallelism --maxWorkers=1 --retry=0 --reporter=dot

denominators.realPostgres: 4 passed / 4 discovered, including real mounted Finance router
denominators.legacyV8Writers: 1 safely retired / 30 inventoried; 29 deliberately not disabled

fixtures.database: fresh isolated PostgreSQL database removed after proof
fixtures.tenants: source tenant with canonical artifact/version alias and foreign tenant reusing the same legacy ID without an alias
fixtures.mountedRoute: real finance.routes mounted at /api/v8/finance with tenant context
fixtures.requestIdentity: stable x-request-id used for concurrent/retry-equivalent repeated guard calls

negativeControls.zeroWriterDefault: POST /models/:id/approve returns 410 FINANCE_LEGACY_WRITER_DISABLED through the real mounted router and never reaches the leaf writer
negativeControls.idempotency: repeating the same tenant/request/path/access observation persists exactly one telemetry row
negativeControls.telemetryFailure: storage failure cannot re-enable the protected writer
negativeControls.rollback: only explicit FINANCE_LEGACY_WRITER_ROLLBACK_ENABLED=true reaches the legacy leaf; rollback observation is durable
negativeControls.tenant: same legacy ID in a foreign tenant resolves no canonical artifact/version
negativeControls.coldReadback: independent pg.Client reads stable canonical artifact and business-version IDs with one row per request/access kind
negativeControls.unprovenSurfaces: 29 uncovered writers remain enabled and visibly classified; no false zero-writer claim

rollback.method: Set FINANCE_LEGACY_WRITER_ROLLBACK_ENABLED=true to temporarily re-enable only the proven model-approval tranche. Remove the new unique index to revert telemetry deduplication; no Finance business data is deleted or rewritten.
rollback.proof: focused unit and real-PG tests observe rollback_writer and next() exactly once
